title: RELATED across a one-to-one relationship is BLANK for a row with no match
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "SKU", Product[SKU], "Category", RELATED ( ProductCategory[Category] ) )

source.quote: Notice that the Category value for product SKU CL-02 is BLANK
source.supports: the page shows these rows in a visual: the Category of CL-02 is BLANK

source.quote: An expanded table contains all the columns of the base table and all the columns of the tables that are linked to the base table through one or more cascading many-to-one or one-to-one relationships
source.supports: table expansion follows one-to-one relationships, so RELATED can read the other table's columns

derivation: CL-01 matches Clothing, AC-01 matches Accessories. CL-02 (Jeans) has no ProductCategory row: BLANK.
